title: Apple’s M5 MacBook Air is down to its lowest price since July

claims.claim: 13 inç MacBook Air şu anda 1.099,99 dolar fiyatla satılmaktadır.

evidence.quote: The latest 13-inch MacBook Air is currently available for $1,099.99

claims.claim: 13 inç MacBook Air'in temel modelinde M5 işlemci, 16GB RAM ve 512GB depolama alanı bulunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: Although the base model — which features Apple’s M5 processor, 16GB of RAM, and 512GB of storage — often sold for around $950 to $1,000 shortly after it launched in May

claims.claim: 13 inç MacBook Air modeli Mayıs ayında piyasaya sürülmüştür.

evidence.quote: Although the base model — which features Apple’s M5 processor, 16GB of RAM, and 512GB of storage — often sold for around $950 to $1,000 shortly after it launched in May

claims.claim: Amazon, Best Buy ve B&H Photo mağazaları 13 inç MacBook Air için 200 dolarlık indirimi tüm renk seçeneklerinde uygulamaktadır.

evidence.quote: Amazon, Best Buy, and B&H Photo are all honoring the price across all color options.

claims.claim: 15 inç MacBook Air modeli 200 dolarlık indirimle 1.299,99 dolara satılmaktadır.

evidence.quote: Apple’s 15-inch MacBook Air is also on sale for $200 off. Amazon, Best Buy, and B&H Photo are each selling the 16GB RAM / 512GB SSD configuration in most colors for $1,299.99.

claims.claim: 15 inç MacBook Air, 13 inç modeline kıyasla altı hoparlörlü bir sisteme ve iki ek GPU çekirdeğine sahiptir.

evidence.quote: If you’d prefer something with a larger screen, a six-speaker array instead of four, and slightly more power (with two additional GPU cores in the M5), Apple’s 15-inch MacBook Air is also on sale for $200 off.

claims.claim: 15 inç MacBook Air'in indirimli satılan konfigürasyonu 16GB RAM ve 512GB SSD içermektedir.

evidence.quote: Amazon, Best Buy, and B&H Photo are each selling the 16GB RAM / 512GB SSD configuration in most colors for $1,299.99.

claims.claim: Antonio G. Di Benedetto'nun MacBook Air incelemeleri yaz aylarındaki fiyat artışlarından önce yayımlanmıştır.

evidence.quote: If you’re still on the fence, though, I’d recommend reading my colleague Antonio G. Di Benedetto’s reviews, both of which were published before the summer price increases.
